title: Supersymmetric Origin of Four-Dimensional Space-time in the IIB Matrix Model
summary: We investigate the constraints imposed by supersymmetry on the IIB matrix model (IKKT model) by requiring both the closure of the transformations and the satisfaction of the Ward identities at the leading order of the order expansion. Following the systematic methodology, we evaluate the most general forms of the effective action and supersymmetry transformations consistent with the $SU(N)$ algebra.
